title.zh-CN: 短期多饮多尿后恶心呕吐与酸中毒
title.en: Nausea, vomiting and acidosis after a short history of thirst and polyuria

summary.zh-CN: 年轻成人短期内出现明显代谢紊乱，随后血糖指标与红细胞资料的差异需要解释。
summary.en: A young adult develops marked metabolic disturbance over a short period, followed by discordance between glycaemic and red-cell findings.

provenance.citation: 叶艺艺, 陆泽元, 邵豪, 赖丽萍, 庄雄杰. 暴发性1型糖尿病并β地中海贫血一例报道. 中华糖尿病杂志. 2010;02(04):307-307. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.1674-5809.2010.04.017.
provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: 2024 adult hyperglycaemic-crises consensus; NIDDK 2020 haemoglobin-variant interpretation and 2023 laboratory-analysis guideline, checked 2026-10-28; scope monitored DKA care, assay/red-cell interference and alternative glycaemic assessment.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 不依赖呼气气味识别酮症酸中毒。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise ketoacidosis without relying on breath odour.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别血红蛋白病对HbA1c推理的限制。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify limits of HbA1c inference in haemoglobin disease.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 制定可靠的血糖和电解质监测计划。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan reliable glucose and electrolyte monitoring.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 多饮多尿五天，恶心呕吐三天
chiefComplaint.en: Thirst and polyuria for five days, with nausea and vomiting for three days

triageNote.zh-CN: 先处理高糖、酸中毒和电解质风险，再解释病型。
triageNote.en: Prioritise hyperglycaemia, acidosis and electrolyte risk before classifying diabetes.

name.zh-CN: 糖代谢与血红蛋白后续记录

zh-CN: 糖代谢与血红蛋白后续记录

text.zh-CN: 次日HbA1c6.8%；酸中毒纠正后空腹/餐后2小时C肽50/70 pmol/L，两周80/100，三个月60/170；GAD、ICA、IAA阴性。血红蛋白110.7–126 g/L、持续小细胞表现，HbA2 4.6%，β珠蛋白17位点M/N杂合。原文MCV单位指数异常，不将其静默改写为已核实数值。
text.en: Next-day HbA1c was 6.8%; fasting/two-hour C-peptide after acidosis correction was 50/70 pmol/L, 80/100 at two weeks and 60/170 at three months. GAD, ICA and IAA were negative. Haemoglobin 110.7–126 g/L with persistent microcytosis, HbA2 4.6% and heterozygous β-globin codon-17 M/N were recorded. The source MCV unit exponent is inconsistent and is not silently converted into a verified value.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 经补液及胰岛素后十二小时pH7.375、碳酸氢根20 mmol/L，次日胰岛素泵治疗；三个月HbA1c6.9%，C肽仍低。未报告长期并发症或进一步完整免疫分型。
text.en: After fluids and insulin, twelve-hour pH was 7.375 with bicarbonate 20 mmol/L; pump treatment began the next day. At three months HbA1c was 6.9% and C-peptide remained low. Long-term complications and further complete immune classification were not reported.

hint.en: Identify localising signs and retain missing information as unknown.

guidance.en: Plan care and review the outcome

prompt.zh-CN: 无烂苹果气味时如何解释急诊资料？
prompt.en: How should the emergency findings be interpreted without fruity breath?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 仍为明确酮症酸中毒表现，需要监测下处理高钾及液体胰岛素问题
text.en: The findings still establish ketoacidosis, requiring monitored potassium, fluid and insulin management

feedback.zh-CN: 高糖、明显酮症和代谢性酸中毒比呼气气味可靠。
feedback.en: Hyperglycaemia, marked ketosis and metabolic acidosis outweigh breath odour.

text.zh-CN: 无特殊气味可排除酮症酸中毒
text.en: Absence of characteristic odour excludes ketoacidosis

feedback.zh-CN: 气味不是必要诊断条件。
feedback.en: Odour is not a required diagnostic condition.

text.zh-CN: 呕吐足以把酸中毒归为普通胃肠炎
text.en: Vomiting is sufficient to attribute acidosis to ordinary gastroenteritis

feedback.zh-CN: 无法解释高糖、强阳性酮体和严重酸中毒的组合。
feedback.en: This does not account for the combination of glucose, ketones and severe acidosis.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 持续很低C肽支持严重胰岛素缺乏，地中海贫血使HbA1c用于推断发病速度存在局限
text.en: Persistently very low C-peptide supports severe insulin deficiency, while thalassaemia limits inference about onset speed from HbA1c

feedback.zh-CN: 原文称暴发型1型；不能仅靠相对低HbA1c证明，也不能断言偏差方向和幅度。
feedback.en: The source labels fulminant type 1; relatively low HbA1c alone does not prove it, nor establish bias direction or magnitude.

text.zh-CN: HbA1c不很高说明没有严重糖尿病
text.en: A modest HbA1c means there is no severe diabetes

feedback.zh-CN: 急性血糖、酮症与C肽资料明确相反。
feedback.en: Acute glucose, ketosis and C-peptide show otherwise.

text.zh-CN: 三个月餐后C肽170可写为永久绝对零分泌
text.en: A three-month stimulated C-peptide of 170 means permanently zero secretion

feedback.zh-CN: 极低不等于零，长期不可逆性也未证实。
feedback.en: Very low is not zero, and permanent irreversibility is not established.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续安全监测应采用什么策略？
prompt.en: What is a safe subsequent monitoring strategy?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 依据实际血糖和持续胰岛素缺乏管理，核对HbA1c方法及红细胞因素，必要时选非血红蛋白指标
text.en: Manage using measured glucose and persistent insulin deficiency; check HbA1c assay/red-cell effects and consider non-haemoglobin markers when needed

feedback.zh-CN: 血红蛋白病可影响解读，但不能凭未核验的偏差停用胰岛素。
feedback.en: A haemoglobin disorder affects interpretation but does not justify stopping insulin on an unverified bias assumption.

text.zh-CN: HbA1c接近7%即可停胰岛素
text.en: Stop insulin because HbA1c is close to 7%

feedback.zh-CN: 残余分泌很低且曾发生酮症酸中毒，停药有危险。
feedback.en: Very low secretion and prior ketoacidosis make this dangerous.

text.zh-CN: 高钾时照所有旧方案立即盲目补钾
text.en: Blindly add potassium immediately despite hyperkalaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 电解质补充必须依据重复化验、心电及治疗变化。
feedback.en: Replacement depends on repeated measurements, ECG and treatment-related changes.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 依实际血糖与电解质监测治疗，不用受干扰HbA1c停胰岛素或盲目补钾
text.en: Use measured glucose and electrolytes, avoiding HbA1c-driven insulin withdrawal or blind potassium replacement

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明临床急症由血糖、酮症和酸碱证据建立。；承认缺少HbA1c具体方法、红细胞寿命测量、完整现代抗体面板及长期随访，MCV单位需核验。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Glucose, ketones and acid-base evidence establish the emergency.; acknowledge HbA1c method, red-cell lifespan measurement, a full modern antibody panel and long-term follow-up are absent; MCV units need verification. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告诊断暴发型1型糖尿病合并β地中海贫血；本改写保留严重胰岛素缺乏证据并限制HbA1c用于定时分型的确定性。
conclusion.en: The source diagnosed fulminant type 1 diabetes with β-thalassaemia; this adaptation retains evidence of severe insulin deficiency while limiting certainty about onset classification based on HbA1c.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 临床急症由血糖、酮症和酸碱证据建立。
keyReasoning.en: Glucose, ketones and acid-base evidence establish the emergency.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 持续C肽低值支持后续胰岛素需求。
keyReasoning.en: Persistently low C-peptide supports ongoing insulin need.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血红蛋白病要求复核HbA1c解释。
keyReasoning.en: A haemoglobin disorder requires reassessment of HbA1c interpretation.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不把极低分泌写成绝对零。
teachingPoints.en: Do not rewrite very low secretion as absolute zero.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 阴性有限抗体面板不证明全部免疫机制均已排除。
teachingPoints.en: A limited negative antibody panel does not exclude every immune mechanism.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 原始单位冲突需显式保留。
teachingPoints.en: Conflicting original units must remain explicit.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少HbA1c具体方法、红细胞寿命测量、完整现代抗体面板及长期随访，MCV单位需核验。
unknowns.en: HbA1c method, red-cell lifespan measurement, a full modern antibody panel and long-term follow-up are absent; MCV units need verification.
